notes: A national 501c3 based in Stamford, Connecticut. Its programs help low-income families, people with disabilities, military families, people experiencing homelessness, seniors on fixed incomes, survivors of domestic violence, and pets displaced by natural disasters. Listed on Bullmastiff Rescuers' resources page.
